assertEquals(iso.toEpochDay(), pax.toEpochDay());
// A date has zero distance to itself. assertEquals(PaxChronology.INSTANCE.period(0, 0, 0), pax.until(pax));
// The Pax date and its equivalent ISO date are the same day, so the period is zero. assertEquals(PaxChronology.INSTANCE.period(0, 0, 0), pax.until(iso));
// The ISO date and its equivalent Pax date are the same day, so the period is zero. assertEquals(Period.ZERO, iso.until(pax));
assertEquals(pax, PaxChronology.INSTANCE.date(iso));

// Adding N days to the Pax date matches adding N days to the equivalent ISO date. assertEquals(iso, LocalDate.from(pax.plus(0, DAYS))); assertEquals(iso.plusDays(1), LocalDate.from(pax.plus(1, DAYS)));

// Subtracting N days from the Pax date matches subtracting N days from the equivalent ISO date. assertEquals(iso, LocalDate.from(pax.minus(0, DAYS))); assertEquals(iso.minusDays(1), LocalDate.from(pax.minus(1, DAYS)));
// The day-count between the Pax date and an ISO date offset by N days is exactly N. assertEquals(0, pax.until(iso.plusDays(0), DAYS)); assertEquals(1, pax.until(iso.plusDays(1), DAYS));
